description: Genotype call sets, phenotypes, analysis scripts and their outputs for the article "How Many Paternal Lines Are Enough? Genomic Prediction of Combining Ability in a Sunflower Breeding Panel" (Divashuk, Borisenko et al., submitted to Genes, MDPI). 54 paternal sunflower lines and three CMS testers genotyped by GBS; 162 hybrids phenotyped in 2022–2023. GBLUP prediction of paternal GCA, parental genetic distance, additive and dominance-deviation association scans. See README.md for the layout and the mapping of scripts to tables and figures.
